**Outlier located.** Pods listing: 10 of 11 services Running, 0 restarts — **`shippingservice` has no pod at all**, while its Deployment reads `0/1` and its Endpoints read `<none>`. The service object itself exists and is well-formed (`ClusterIP 10.68.123.226`, `50051/TCP`), so this is not a selector/port/addressing fault — the pod was **never created**.

exceeded quota: memory-request-quota, requested: requests.memory=300Mi,
used: requests.memory=3000Mi, limited: requests.memory=3Gi
```

**Config face closed.** The referenced object is live and is the quota itself:

```
NAME                   REQUEST
memory-request-quota   requests.memory: 3000Mi/3Gi
```

So the hard cap is `3Gi` (3072Mi) with `3000Mi` already committed — only ~72Mi free, while `shippingservice` requests `300Mi` (`GetAppYAML`: `requests.memory: 300Mi`). Admission is refused, the ReplicaSet cannot bring up any replica, and with zero ready endpoints the Service becomes unreachable — exactly the reported availability disruption.
